title: Phone: tapping a record chip inside a lookup picker option's preview opens that record instead of selecting the option
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found by the #36151 dev (PR #36478) while running the phone record page at 375 px. Out of that card's scope. Filed by the seat.

## What happens

On the showcase Field Zoo record at 375 px wide:

1. Start inline edit of the Master-Detail field (target: Project).
2. Tap the field to open the lookup picker.
3. Inside an option's preview, tap the record chip `Account: Fabrikam`.

The Fabrikam account record page opens, in the middle of the edit. The option is not selected and the edit is left behind.

## What should happen

A tap anywhere on a picker option selects that option. A record chip inside an option's preview should not navigate while the picker is open (either it is not a link there, or the tap is taken as the option's own select).

## Notes

- Seen on a phone width. Desktop with a pointer was not checked; the fix should say whether the same click navigates there too.
- Dedupe words: lookup picker option preview link navigates selects phone.
- A screenshot exists in the f7-record thread if the dev needs one.
